folds.title: Misses are normal
points: That is rarely a reason to give up.
Most misses can be fixed with one good follow-up.

folds.title: Name the problem
points: Wrong tone, too long, something missing, or just incorrect?
Naming the problem is half the fix.

folds.title: Then fix it
items: Say exactly what is wrong: "too formal", "you skipped the second question".
Add the context you left out the first time.
Still stuck? Start a fresh chat with a better first prompt.

chat.you: Write a note asking my boss for Friday off.

chat.claude: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to formally request...

chat.you: Too formal. We are friendly. Two short lines, please.

chat.claude: Hi Sam, could I take Friday off? Happy to cover anything urgent first.

folds.title: If it seems wrong
points: Ask Claude to check again and give its source.
Do not just ask for the same thing a third time.

folds.question: Claude wrote a 500-word summary, but you wanted something short. Which follow-up is best?
options: Too long. Cut it to three bullet points, keeping the main decision.
Why did you write so much?
folds.why: It names the problem and says what you want instead. Vague complaints make Claude guess.
